abstract.para: After a disaster has occurred, replace any broken hardware (if necessary). Then boot the &rear; recovery system and start the recovery installer with the rear recover command.

topic.para: In case a disaster has occurred, replace any broken hardware if necessary. Then proceed as described in , using either the repaired machine (or a tested, identical machine that can serve as a replacement for your original system).
The rear recover command executes the following steps:

listitem.para: Restoring the disk layout (partitions, file systems, and mount points).
Restoring the system and user files from the backup.
